keyHints.SALARY_EXPENSE: Debited with the gross salary of every payroll run.
keyHints.GOSI_EMPLOYER_EXPENSE: Debited with the employer's share of GOSI contributions.
keyHints.GOSI_PAYABLE: Credited with the combined GOSI liability (employee + employer) until remitted.
keyHints.NET_PAY_PAYABLE: Credited with what is owed to employees after a payroll run.
keyHints.SALARY_ADVANCES_RECEIVABLE: Debited when an advance is granted, credited as it is recovered.
keyHints.EOSB_EXPENSE: Debited when an end-of-service gratuity is accrued.
keyHints.EOSB_PAYABLE: Credited with the end-of-service amount owed until paid.

keyHints.EMPLOYEE_EOSB_PARENT: A folder account (not one that takes entries) for each employee's dues: what is owed to them besides salary (end-of-service now, leave or bonuses later). In the standard chart, "Employees Other Dues" (2111102) fits. Set all three employee folders, or none to keep using the company-wide accounts above.

setup.suggestionsWarning: These are proposals read from the standard chart, not accounting rulings. Review each one, ideally with your accountant, and tick only what you agree with. Nothing is created or linked until you confirm.
setup.createUnder: Create the account "{{name}}" ({{code}}) inside the folder {{folder}}, and link it
setup.noSuggestions: No proposals: everything that can be proposed is already linked, or your chart is not the standard one. Link the rest by hand.

drafts.title: My drafts
drafts.subtitle: Your private working copies, saved on the server. They do not affect accounts or stock until posted.
drafts.error: Latest changes were not saved. Retry before leaving.
drafts.conflict: This draft changed or is no longer available. Reload to restore the saved version; older changes will not overwrite it.
drafts.confirmDiscard: Discard this draft? Posted documents will not be affected.

trail.title: Track document
trail.subtitle: Linked documents in creation order, within your permissions.
trail.truncated: This chain is large; open a linked document to explore further relationships.

errors.generic: Unable to post the return. Check the date, warehouse and account mappings, then retry.
errors.OVER_RETURN: Quantity exceeds the remaining returnable quantity. Refresh the invoice.
errors.INVALID_RETURN: Check the original invoice lines and return date.
errors.INSUFFICIENT_STOCK: Not enough stock in the selected warehouse.
errors.CREDIT_EXCEEDS_INVOICE: Return value exceeds the invoice remaining after previous notes.
errors.DEBIT_EXCEEDS_INVOICE: Return value exceeds the invoice remaining after previous notes.
errors.NO_OPEN_PERIOD: No open fiscal period covers the return date.

returns.chooseWarehouse: Choose the warehouse receiving the goods
returns.purchaseHint: Create a purchase return from the original supplier invoice, then select quantities and the warehouse.

imports.title: Import {{kind}}
imports.hint: Upload XLSX (first worksheet) or CSV. Maximum 200 rows and 2 MB. Download the column template; preview does not save anything. Correct errors in your file and upload it again.
imports.kindsHint: Party kinds: COMPANY, PERSON, OTHER. Import employees through HR. Keep phone numbers and identifiers as text in Excel to preserve leading zeros.
imports.skipInvalid: Import only valid rows; skip the rows with errors

errors.FILE_LIMIT: File is too large or complex. Use a smaller workbook.
errors.ROW_LIMIT: Choose a file containing 1–200 data rows.
errors.INVALID_HEADERS: Column headings must be unique and non-empty. Use the template.
errors.INVALID_FILE: Cannot read this file. Choose a valid XLSX or CSV file.
errors.REQUEST_FAILED: Preview failed. Check your connection and try again.
errors.COMMIT_FAILED: Save could not be confirmed. Review the refreshed preview and the list before retrying; existing records are flagged as duplicates.
errors.INVALID_DECIMAL: Use a non-negative decimal with at most four decimal places

replenishment.quantityError: Enter a positive quantity no greater than {{max}}, with up to four decimal places.
replenishment.title: Suggested purchase requests
replenishment.hint: Choose a warehouse, select items and review quantities. Creating a request submits it for review; it does not place an order or change stock. Up to 100 items per request.
replenishment.formula: Suggested quantity = reorder point − on-hand stock − pending/accepted requests − unreceived open orders, with a minimum of zero. Quantities may be reduced before submission.
replenishment.error: Unable to complete the operation. Quantities may have changed; refresh suggestions and review your selection.

emailHistory.title: Email history
emailHistory.hint: Accepted means the provider accepted the message; Delivered means the recipient server accepted it. Refresh delivery status for Resend. SMTP acceptance and Gmail drafts cannot confirm delivery. Unknown or stuck sending attempts require checking with the provider before sending again. Times are shown in Riyadh time.
emailHistory.error: Unable to load or refresh delivery status. A Resend key with email-read access is required to check delivery.
